title: 第4章 鸿门赢家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

提起鸿门宴，大多数人脑海中会浮现刀光剑影、杀机四伏的场景：项羽设局欲杀刘邦；项庄舞剑，意在沛公；樊哙闯帐，怒目圆睁……

然而真实的历史却与戏剧化的演绎大相径庭，真相是这场饭局既非精心策划的“杀局”，也非项羽“妇人之仁”的失误，而是一场临时起意的和解宴。从结果看，项羽获得的好处更多。司马迁在《史记·项羽本纪》中仅以【项王即日因留沛公与饮】寥寥数字记载，既无预谋，也无周密部署。

秦末天下大乱，楚怀王为激励诸侯，立下“先入关中者王之”的约定。刘邦避开秦军主力，迂回攻入武关，于前206年接受秦王子婴的投降占领咸阳。项羽则在巨鹿之战中以少胜多，歼灭秦军主力，成为诸侯联军领袖。

然而矛盾来了，刘邦虽然先入关，但实力远逊项羽，刘邦军10万，项羽军40万，而且项羽自认灭秦首功，对刘邦“捡漏”的行为极为不满。

当项羽得知刘邦有意在关中称王时，他其实有两个选择。一是用武力直接扫平刘邦军；二是以武力威胁，逼迫刘邦自己主动放弃称王，拱手让出关中，听从他的处分。

选择第一种武力解决，项羽有这个能力，也有这个实力将刘邦及其所部击溃乃至全歼。但项羽并没有这么做，至于原因，樊哙在鸿门宴上说出了部分原因。

首先，刘邦无罪，而且有功。刘邦亡秦在先，举世皆知，他有大功。至于封闭函谷关之类属于小过，构不成攻伐的罪名。

其次，樊哙没说，但项羽清楚，刘邦也并不是那么容易被击败的，项羽率领的40万军队不全是他的部队，这里面他的楚军只有10余万，剩下的20多万都是归其指挥、听其调令的诸侯军。刘邦此时也拥兵10万，项羽在兵力上的优势并不明显，那些诸侯军在两人开战时会不会不听指挥，再来一次作壁上观？项羽也不敢确定。

诸侯们合力灭秦，现在最想做的事是什么？当然是瓜分胜利果实。最简单的方式就是会师关中，然后一通乱抢。刘邦锁关行为在诸侯看来就是“吃独食”，所以大伙一股脑跟着项羽干他。不是项羽可以指挥大家，而是大家不爽刘邦，刘邦这时候成了天下公敌。

联军进关后发现他驻军灞上，而且咸阳城里那点东西也没怎么动。这时候诸侯对于刘邦的仇恨度也就不高了，因为好不容易打赢了秦军，这次入关摆明了是抢钱而不是内讧的。刘邦驻军灞上是公开行为，也证明了刘邦没有想自己独吞财富。大伙都知道，项羽当然也知道。所以大伙根本没有打刘邦的理由。

诸侯承认了项羽的统帅地位，但是刘邦并没有在巨鹿，他是自己入关的，而不是和大伙一起，所以项羽需要知道刘邦的态度，简单来说就是我现在是老大，你服不服？

刘邦和联军既没有一起打仗的友情，也没有私下联系，所以如果不服项羽，那么项羽随便找个借口，说刘邦不满意我们入关，想独吞胜利果实，刘邦又会处于全民公敌的位置。所以如果你不满项羽，就会变成对诸侯联军的不满，项羽此时占据联军统帅地位，鸿门宴本质上就是刘邦服软承认项羽的地位。

Page (1/3)

When mentioning the Hongmen Banquet, most people will think of scenes of swords and swords and murderous intent: Xiang Yu set up a trap to kill Liu Bang; Xiang Zhuang danced with his sword, aiming at Pei Gong; Fan Kuai broke into the tent with angry eyes...

However, the real history is very different from the dramatic interpretation. The truth is that this dinner was neither a carefully planned "killing game" nor a mistake of Xiang Yu's "women's kindness", but an impromptu reconciliation banquet.Judging from the results, Xiang Yu gained more benefits.Sima Qian recorded only a few numbers in "Historical Records of Xiang Yu": "King Xiang stayed with Duke Pei to drink with him today". There was no premeditation or careful deployment.

At the end of the Qin Dynasty, the world was in chaos. In order to encourage the princes, King Huai of Chu made an agreement that "the one who enters Guanzhong first will be the king."Liu Bang avoided the main force of the Qin army and attacked Wuguan in a roundabout way. In 206 BC, he accepted the surrender of Qin Prince Ying and occupied Xianyang.Xiang Yu defeated the majority with a small number in the Battle of Julu, annihilated the main force of the Qin army, and became the leader of the coalition of princes.

However, a conflict arose. Although Liu Bang entered the Pass first, his strength was far inferior to Xiang Yu's. Liu Bang's army was 100,000, while Xiang Yu's army was 400,000. Moreover, Xiang Yu believed that he was the first to destroy Qin and was extremely dissatisfied with Liu Bang's behavior of "picking up leaks".

When Xiang Yu learned that Liu Bang intended to become king in Guanzhong, he actually had two choices.The first is to use force to directly defeat Liu Bang's army; the second is to threaten force to force Liu Bang to voluntarily give up the title of king, surrender Guanzhong, and obey his punishment.

Choose the first method of using force to solve the problem. Xiang Yu has this ability and the strength to defeat or even annihilate Liu Bang and his troops.But Xiang Yu did not do this. As for the reason, Fan Kuai told part of the reason at the Hongmen Banquet.

First of all, Liu Bang is not guilty and has meritorious service.Liu Bang was the first to overthrow the Qin Dynasty, and everyone in the world knows that he has made great contributions.As for sealing Hangu Pass, it was a minor offense and did not constitute an attack.

Secondly, Fan Kuai didn't say it, but Xiang Yu knew that Liu Bang was not that easy to defeat. Not all of the 400,000 troops led by Xiang Yu were his troops. Among them, he only had more than 100,000 Chu troops, and the remaining 200,000 troops were all princes' armies under his command and under his orders.Liu Bang also has 100,000 troops at this time, and Xiang Yu's advantage in military strength is not obvious. Will the princes' troops disobey the command and watch on the sidelines again when the two fight?Xiang Yu is not sure either.

The princes worked together to destroy Qin. What do they want to do most now?Of course, it is to divide the fruits of victory.The simplest way is to join forces in Guanzhong and then grab them all at once.Liu Bang's behavior of locking the pass was regarded by the princes as "eating alone", so everyone followed Xiang Yu to do him.It's not that Xiang Yu can command everyone, but that everyone is unhappy with Liu Bang, and Liu Bang has become the public enemy of the world at this time.

After the coalition forces entered the pass, they found that he was stationed in Bashang, and that nothing in Xianyang City had been moved much.At this time, the hatred of the princes towards Liu Bang was not high, because they finally defeated the Qin army, and it was clear that this entry was for money grabbing rather than internal strife.Liu Bang's garrison in Bashang was an open act, which also proved that Liu Bang did not want to monopolize the wealth for himself.Everyone knows it, and Xiang Yu certainly knows it too.So everyone has no reason to fight Liu Bang.

The princes recognized Xiang Yu's status as commander, but Liu Bang was not in Julu. He entered the pass by himself, not with everyone, so Xiang Yu needs to know Liu Bang's attitude. To put it simply, I am the boss now. Do you accept it?

Liu Bang and the coalition forces have neither the friendship of fighting together nor personal contact, so if Xiang Yu is not convinced, then Xiang Yu can just find an excuse, saying that Liu Bang is not satisfied with our entry and wants to monopolize the fruits of victory, and Liu Bang will be in the position of a public enemy.So if you are dissatisfied with Xiang Yu, it will become dissatisfaction with the coalition of princes. Xiang Yu now occupies the position of commander of the coalition. The Hongmen Banquet is essentially Liu Bang's submission and recognition of Xiang Yu's status.
